description: Start here when you do not already have a vault address. Answers "which vaults for this asset on this chain?": returns a short ranked list (default 5, max 10) of scored vaults with composite, label, live APY/TVL, risk flags (thin_tvl, apy_outlier, ...), whether a deposit can reach it (routable), and a citable page URL. It also returns what the filters REMOVED: counts per filter, the best-ranked dropped vaults with reasons, near-miss asset symbols, and whether more matched than were returned. Vaults with no deposit route and rows scored on fallback data are excluded. Ranked by the chosen metric, a ranking and not a recommendation. A flag is a caution, not a verdict, and no flag does not mean safe. Take a chosen vaultId/address to check_route_survival before any deposit. Read-only.

asset.description: Underlying asset symbol, or a list of up to 10, e.g. USDC or ["USDC","USDT0"]. Exact match: USDC does not include syrupUSDC (similarAssets lists near misses)

chain.description: Chain name (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, bnb, solana) or EVM chain id

minApy.description: Minimum live APY in percentage points, e.g. 10 for 10%

protocolId.description: Protocol slug, e.g. morpho, aave-v3, pendle

sortBy.description: Rank by this, descending. Default composite

name: find_vaults
title: Find vaults
